terms.gloss: an aperitif, a drink before a meal
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “a drink taken before eating, a whet (postclass.)”; Greek πρόπομα. Nearer an aperitif than a mixed drink.
Lewis & Short: “a mixed drink of spelt-grain and wine”, from Arnobius and Nonius.

sources: Lewis & Short: propoma · Lewis & Short: cinnus
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 70.
